user.title: SSH Connection
user.description: Configure SSH connection to the remote host running smartctl.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the remote system
data_description.private_key: Paste your private key in PEM format (starts with -----BEGIN)
data_description.host_key_policy: How to handle unknown host keys
data_description.sudo_mode: Whether to use sudo for smartctl commands

devices.title: Devices and Command
devices.description: Configure which devices to monitor and how to query them.

data_description.command_template: Command to run for each device. Use {device} as placeholder.
data_description.device_alias_command: Command to get friendly device names (e.g., /usr/syno/bin/synodisk --enum for Synology)
data_description.device_alias_format: How to parse the alias command output

options.title: Polling and Thresholds
options.description: Configure how often to poll and when to consider a drive failing.

data.fail_if_pending_gt: Fail if pending sectors greater than
data.fail_if_offline_unc_gt: Fail if offline uncorrectable greater than
data.fail_if_reported_unc_gt: Fail if reported uncorrectable greater than
data.warn_if_realloc_delta_gt: Warn if reallocated sectors delta greater than

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll SMART data (in minutes)
data_description.max_parallel: Maximum number of concurrent smartctl commands
data_description.fail_mode: What to do when a device query fails

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the remote host. Check host, port, and network.
error.auth_failed: SSH authentication failed. Check username, password, or private key.
error.command_failed: smartctl command failed or returned invalid output.
error.no_devices: At least one device must be specified.

reset_deltas.name: Reset Delta Counters
reset_deltas.description: Reset delta counters for one or all drives. Sets the current metric values as the new baseline.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device to reset. If not specified, resets all devices.
